# Generated -- do not edit by hand

This tree is generated by `scripts/build_fabric_sync.py` from `notebooks/**`. It exists only so Fabric's Git integration (pointed at this folder, not the repo root) can sync real Notebook items -- Fabric requires each item as a `<DisplayName>.Notebook/` folder with a `.platform` descriptor, which `notebooks/**` deliberately doesn't have, to keep it plainly testable/importable outside Fabric.

Regenerate after any `notebook.py`/`transforms.py` change:

```
python scripts/build_fabric_sync.py
```
